Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 542 PM EST Mon Nov 23 2026
 

- Scattered rain/snow showers this afternoon transition to mainly 
snow this evening. Pockets of brief, intense snowfall will be 
possible north of a line from Owosso to Mt. Clemens.

- Widespread rain on Thursday and Friday with rain/snow mix possible 
Thursday night and Friday night.

&&

.AVIATION...

A strong upper trough now tracking across Lower Mi is driving 
scattered to numerous rain/snow showers across Se Mi, aided by the 
moisture flux off the Great Lakes. Observational trends suggest the 
higher intensity showers have transitioned to all snow, while 
boundary layer temps remain warm enough to keep the lighter intensity 
showers rain. The ascent tied to this system will exit east of the 
terminals between 01Z and 03Z and will be followed by a strong push 
of large scale subsidence. This along with a wind shift toward the 
north will support clear skies during the overnight through Tuesday 
as high pressure expands into the area from the west.

For DTW...There remains a chance of brief rain/snow showers this 
evening, mainly through 02Z. Given warm ground temperatures and with 
air temperatures around 40, no accumulations are expected with any 
accumulations. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Moderate in ceilings below 5000 feet this evening. 

* Medium confidence in precip type being melting snow this evening.
